correctness.rationale: The deterministically equivalent event F_top union F_bottom for n>=5 is cited to Brandt–Chen–Dong–Lederer–Schlenga Theorem 2, not reinvented. Mallows first-choice probabilities are a_n q^(c-1), and second choices conditional on first are b_n q^(h-1-1_{h>c}). Exact distinct-top event probability A_n=n!a_n^n q^{n(n-1)/2}; exactly one duplicate top with two seconds equal to the unchosen house contributes E_n and E_n/A_n→(1+q^2)/(2q(1+q)). Position+label reversal gives bottom symmetry. A conditional suffix union bound makes top∩bottom=o(A_n) for fixed 0<q<1, producing C(q). The q=1 uniform case is calculated separately and yields factor 3. Exact finite first/second event probabilities were independently checked for n=3,4,5; n<5 never tests the external top-cycle classification.
